question: Ideation gate: approve the nemotron-mlx ASR backend implementation plan + ACs?

artifacts.summary: Ideation complete. Plan: create asr_nemotron_mlx.py porting livecaption's _StreamingEncoder + _decode_chunk (greedy RNN-T → ASRToken via AlignedToken.start mid-decode) + _finalize + mel holdback + VAD endpointer; skip the wrapper layer (transducer is monotonic + has native timestamps); register in core/config/parse_args/backend_support + pyproject nemotron-mlx-asr extra. 4 ACs (in-process zh, per-token start mid-decode, coexists with mlx-lm on transformers 5.x, second language); 4 unit tests mocking the model; zh-tw=zh-CN documented as known limitation; benchmark out of scope (consumes AccessibleBoundary adapter).
